scope: Current user visible conversations only; counts contain no message content

states.working: Active bound invocation, WS turn, or live ACP prompt
states.waiting: HITL or ACP permission pending; wins over ordinary active markers on the same thread
states.idle: No observed active or waiting visible conversations

checks.acp_lock_contention: Read-only snapshot deadline 0.2s; does not cancel real handshake; other expert remains observable

runtime.working_and_waiting_verified_by: isolated tests; no live model request or user-data mutation
runtime.acp_timeout_protection: Installed to disk after initial restart; loads on next normal app start. User resumed app use, so no second restart was performed.

git.release_publishing: disabled for push; existing Release remains immutable
